highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: At California State University, East Bay (CSU East Bay), you'll get an education that emphasises innovation and community engagement. The university offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in Business, Education, Engineering, Health Sciences, and Humanities.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: CSU East Bay offers you a vibrant student experience, where you'll be part of a diverse student community from over 50 countries. With more than 100 student organisations, clubs, and sports teams, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to make friends.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
You have various on-campus housing options at CSU East Bay. You can choose from traditional residence halls or apartment-style living spaces, all equipped with modern amenities and just a short walk from campus facilities. If you’re looking for off-campus accommodations, the university also provides resources and listings to help you find housing options nearby.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The CSU East Bay Library provides you with a comprehensive collection of books, electronic journals, and online databases to support your academic work. Here, you’ll find study rooms, computer labs, and access to research resources.

Sports
You can be part of CSU East Bay’s athletic program in a wide range of competitive sports teams, from basketball to cross country. Plus, you’ll find many top-notch sports facilities at the university, including the Pioneer Gym and the Hayward Hills, where you can enjoy both recreational and intramural sports.

Laboratory
On campus, you’ll find many state-of-the-art labs for disciplines such as biology, chemistry, engineering, and computer science.

Cafeteria
You’ll find a lot of places to eat on campus, such as the Dining Commons restaurant, and eateries like Pioneer Kitchen and The Market. Additionally, there are nearby restaurants and coffee shops like Pearl's, Tutuli, and Brewja Coffee that you can visit. The university also offers you several meal plans.
